text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One key issue is bias: if the data used to train AI is unfair, the system can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating everyone equally, regardless of their background. Privacy is also essential, because AI often collects personal information, and this data must be protected. Transparency matters too, since people should understand how AI systems make decisions. Finally, responsible AI development requires governments, companies, and researchers to work together and create clear rules that protect users and build trust.
